idea-plugin.name: Protostuff Tag Annotator
idea-plugin.description:
Adds Protostuff @Tag annotations to the fields of a Java class. See protostuff-runtime.

How to use: put the caret inside a class, then Code | Generate (Alt+Insert, Cmd+N on macOS) and choose Generate Protostuff Tags.

  • Adds import io.protostuff.Tag when Protostuff is on the classpath.
  • Fields that already have a @Tag are left alone, and their numbers are never reused.
  • Numbers used by superclass fields are reserved, so subclasses don't clash with them.
  • Static fields are skipped; transient fields are skipped unless you choose to tag them.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • Adds the io.protostuff.Tag import.
  • Running the action again no longer duplicates tags; existing tag numbers are kept and skipped.
  • The starting number is validated in the dialog.
  • Static fields are never tagged.
  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 and later.
